record.paper_title: Open Problems in the Topology of Manifolds
record.original_question: For compact aspherical 4-manifolds with boundary, in the same setting where topological surgery applies to good fundamental groups, what homeomorphism types can occur among the boundary components?

evidence.quote: 2. Determine the possible fundamental groups of the boundary components. 3. Determine the homeomorphism types of the boundary components.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a compact connected aspherical topological 4-manifold with nonempty boundary, and assume that $\pi_1(M)$ is a "good" group in the sense of Freedman–Quinn (so that topological surgery and the s-cobordism theorem are available in dimension 4 for this fundamental group). The boundary $\partial M$ is then a closed (possibly disconnected) topological 3-manifold.

Determine, as completely as possible, which homeomorphism types of closed 3-manifolds can occur as components of $\partial M$ under these hypotheses. Equivalently, classify the closed 3-manifolds $N$ for which there exists a compact aspherical topological 4-manifold $M$ with good fundamental group such that $N$ is homeomorphic to a connected component of $\partial M$.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (2025) classifies the closed 3-manifolds that arise as the boundary of a compact aspherical 4-manifold with elementary amenable (hence good) fundamental group, generalizing results of Freedman–Quinn for trivial and infinite cyclic fundamental groups. A full classification beyond the elementary amenable case is not yet established, so the problem is partially solved.

status_evidence.title: The Borel Conjecture for manifolds with boundary
status_evidence.snippet: The closed 3-manifolds which arise as the boundary of a compact aspherical 4-manifold with elementary amenable fundamental group have been classified, generalizing results of Freedman and Quinn.
status_evidence.claim: Boundary 3-manifolds for compact aspherical 4-manifolds with elementary amenable π1 are classified.

status_evidence.title: arXiv:2501.12512 [math.GT]
status_evidence.snippet: Fundamental groups of compact aspherical 4-manifolds with boundary considered are polycyclic or solvable Baumslag-Solitar; these are good and satisfy topological rigidity.
status_evidence.claim: Partial classification results in the good (elementary amenable) case.
